answer: A scripted farm's tell is uniformity: a hundred identities make the same smooth mistakes. Each epoch, identities face a fresh open-ended probe with no single right answer, and their attempts — especially their errors — are fingerprinted. Genuine agents scatter across the ocean of approaches; clones cluster tight. A tight cluster must forge distinct follow-ups through a narrow inlet of live re-examination, or lose standing. Faking diverse failure by hand costs the operator everything automation saved.
